heading: Tonight
text: Partly cloudy, becoming mostly cloudy as clouds increase from the south overnight. Lows mainly from the mid teens to low 20s. Calm wind.

heading: Thursday/ Thanksgiving
text: Precipitation developing south in the afternoon, then spreading north. Freezing rain possible over higher elevations. Valley highs in the low to mid 40s, cooler over higher elevations. Wind becoming east at 5 to 10 mph north, stronger speeds south, with 35 mph gusts.

heading: Thursday Night
text: Widespread precipitation, with rain likely in the valleys, and a chance for freezing rain over the higher hills and mountains. Lows in the low to mid 30s, cooler over higher terrain. East wind 5 to 15 mph north, stronger south with 30 to 40 mph gusts.
